name: EPIC 201433781
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 10, 9.8 solar radii and 0.89 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201433781 (K2 campaign 10): PARAM radius (solar radii) 9.760261 (16th-84th percentiles 9.407379-10.266965), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201433781 (K2 campaign 10): PARAM mass (solar masses) 0.894697 (16th-84th percentiles 0.820594-1.012851), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201433781: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4618.7124 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201433781 (K2 campaign 10): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 3385.546875 (16th-84th percentiles 3275.117188-3529.609375), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.04 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the colour routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 3,386 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 10, give 0.89 solar masses and 9.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,619 K at its surface.
